data.name: Eva Woo
data.repertoireExamples: Brahms Piano Quintet, 4th movement (second violin), currently working on Chaminade Piano Trio No. 2, 3rd movement
data.introduction: I am already part of a pre-formed group but really enjoy reading! I prefer to play second violin whenever possible.

data.name: Kenneth Peterson
data.repertoireExamples: Brahms piano quintet mvt IV, schumann piano quartet mvts II, IV
data.introduction: Interested in playing with just about anyone any time!

data.name: Kelley Yuan
data.repertoireExamples: Brahms piano quintet, Schumann piano quartet, Mendelssohn op. 49 trio, etc.
data.introduction: Happy to drive within the bay area if there's a space with a piano that's more conveniently located for others! I prefer to work on music preparing for performance rather than casual reading.

data.name: Yvonne Wu
data.repertoireExamples: Dvorak "Dumky" trio, Brahms piano quartet in C minor

data.name: Alex Li
data.playingLevel: Flexible...a bit lazy about practicing more technical/demanding work...
data.repertoireExamples: Brahms horn trio 1st mvmt, Bach triple violin concerto 1064, Turina piano trio mvmt.1; franck violin sonata 1st and 4th mvmts; tango piano - no te apures carablanca, cafe dominguez, naranjo en flor, etc.
data.introduction: Would be happy to play casually but would prefer getting a chance to look at piano parts in advance for more demanding pieces. Also interested in tango music and accompaniment. Need a piano to play on.

data.name: Russell Vance
data.repertoireExamples: Faure D minor piano trio, Brahms clarinet quintet
data.introduction: Played seriously for ~20 years and then life, career, kids intervened — and am now back to playing regularly for the past 2 years. I also play in the Prometheus Orchestra.

data.name: Leslie Teicholz
data.repertoireExamples: Schumann Piano Quartet and Quintet, Dvorak Piano Quartet, Beethoven Archduke Trio, Schubert Piano Trios etc.
data.introduction: I would love to get together to read through music! I need the score in advance but can come up to speed for casual reading pretty quickly. I will need longer for Brahms :)
